component.name: Myna Whisper Inference Service
component.summary: Whisper speech-to-text inference service for Myna

description.p: Local, offline speech-to-text service exposing the Myna session API on a Unix domain socket. Wraps OpenAI Whisper models served via faster-whisper (CTranslate2).
Receives raw audio pushed from the Myna desktop client over a shared Unix socket. Has no microphone access and makes no network calls during transcription.
